germ_set.note: m enters as a dimensionful scale leaf; forced germs unchanged; FDR library = full 25-germ pool (non-smuggle)

depth_bound.rationale: D=5 the task's stated bound (the null's first live depth); D=6,7 the budget-limited legs where the mass germ can first combine into a dimensionless bridge (m c^2/E_dS-class needs b_s>=3 -> depth>=7)

targets.note: m_e/m ~ 100.4  (the m_e/100 class pair; A03 at 0.39%, no mechanism)

independence_vs_phase1_19.note: new target reachable from the phase-1 19 VALUES by the search's own MUL/DIV/SQRT/POW -> free
